overlappingReports.note: Each GET /reports/sales runs 2 statements (pg_sleep, then the aggregate). The 4 reports overlap, so timing gives every one of their statements to whichever report was in flight; in this recording the queries per request read 7, 1, 0 and 0. The trace-tagged recording reads 2, 2, 2 and 2.

variesByCapture: Which report collects the statements depends on scheduling. Over five captures, ambiguousStatements was 7 or 8 and the busiest report was given 7 or 8 statements; exactStatements was always 0 and attributedStatements always 31.
